findings.current: “I don’t know. If my guess is right, his eyes may roll back in his head, and I have no idea what he might do.”
findings.defect: The draft changes the implied subject from Taekyung to an unidentified third party. Taekyung is saying that if his suspicion proves correct, he himself may lose control.
findings.rationale: The surrounding exchange concerns what Taekyung plans to do, and his next answer concedes that he may storm Myeongdong Guild. The third-person pronouns alter the actor and meaning of the warning.
findings.replacement: “Hard to say. If my hunch is right, I might see red, and even I don’t know what I’ll do.”
findings.source: ‘글쎄요. 제 짐작이 맞으면 눈깔이 뒤집혀서 무슨 짓을 할지 모르겠는데.’

findings.current: Over the middle-aged man’s shoulder, he spotted more than a hundred Myeongdong Guild members lying collapsed on the floor. His eyes widened.
findings.defect: The draft turns an approximate quantity into a definite lower bound.
findings.rationale: 백여 명 means approximately one hundred people, not specifically more than one hundred.
findings.replacement: Over the middle-aged man’s shoulder, he spotted roughly a hundred Myeongdong Guild members lying collapsed on the floor. His eyes widened.
findings.source: 중년 사내의 어깨너머, 쓰러져 있는 백여 명의 명동 길드원들을 발견한 그가 눈을 부릅떴다.

findings.current: “Was it about twenty years ago? One day, you came to me and dropped to your knees without so much as a word.”
findings.defect: The draft adds that Park Tae Seop said nothing, whereas the source only says that he abruptly dropped to his knees.
findings.rationale: 대뜸 conveys suddenness or lack of preamble, not literal silence.
findings.replacement: “Was it about twenty years ago? One day, you came to me and abruptly dropped to your knees.”
findings.source: “20년쯤 전인가. 어느 날 자네가 나를 찾아와 대뜸 무릎을 꿇었었지.”

findings.current: “I was just testing him. I wanted to see how he would respond.”
findings.defect: The draft supplies a masculine singular target that the Korean omits, making the probe appear to concern Park Tae Seop. The following explanation instead frames the entire operation as a tentative probe conducted through the half-baked Myeongdong operatives.
findings.rationale: The source leaves the target of the probe implicit. Preserving that ambiguity avoids falsely identifying Park Tae Seop as the person Lee Jungryong was testing.
findings.replacement: “I only gave things a little prod. I wanted to see what the response would be.”
findings.source: “한번 찔러 본 거라는 말일세. 어떻게 대응할지 궁금했거든.”

findings.current: The mages had simply blanketed everything within a radius of more than two hundred meters with an illusion spell. It was something they could do because they were A-rank mages of Ares Guild, which selected only the best.
findings.defect: The draft loses the source’s emphasis on the spell’s brute-force extravagance and changes an approximate two-hundred-meter radius into more than two hundred meters.
findings.rationale: 무식하게도 characterizes the method as crudely overwhelming, while 이백여 미터 indicates an approximate radius.
findings.replacement: In a brute-force move, the mages had blanketed everything within a radius of roughly two hundred meters with an illusion spell. They could pull it off because they were A-rank mages of Ares Guild, which selected only the best.
findings.source: 그들은 무식하게도 환영 마법으로 반경 이백여 미터를 덮어 버렸다. 최고만 가려 뽑는 아레스 길드의 A급 마법사이기에 할 수 있는 일이다.

findings.current: Through Park Jihoon, Lee Jungryong had confirmed the poison in Jin Taekyung’s heart.
findings.defect: The literal phrase “poison in Jin Taekyung’s heart” is opaque and does not naturally convey Lee Jungryong’s assessment of Taekyung’s capacity for ruthlessness.
findings.rationale: 독심 here denotes a ruthless or vicious disposition, which Lee evaluates by observing how far Taekyung is willing to go against Park Jihoon.
findings.replacement: Through Park Jihoon, Lee Jungryong had gotten a measure of Jin Taekyung’s ruthlessness.
findings.source: 박지훈을 통해 진태경의 독심(毒心)을 확인할 수 있었다.

findings.defect: “Ineptitude” attributes a lack of competence, but Lee Jungryong is condemning Taekyung’s incomplete measure—mutilating Park Jihoon without finishing him.
findings.rationale: 그 어설픔 refers to the incompleteness of Taekyung’s revenge and his failure to take the final step of killing his enemy, not deficient fighting skill.
findings.replacement: *That half measure will come back to poison you someday.*

summary: One critical subject error and several localized fidelity, ambiguity, quantity, and terminology issues.
